timeline.boosted_by.description: Line above a post in a timeline that someone else shared (boosted). {name} is the display name of the account that boosted it.

timeline.content_warning.toggle.description: Button next to a post's content warning that shows or hides the post behind it. The same text is used while the post is shown.

timeline.empty.account.heading.defaultMessage: まだ投稿はありません
timeline.empty.account.heading.description: Shown instead of the posts of a profile's tab when it has none.

timeline.empty.bookmarks.description.defaultMessage: ブックマークした投稿がここに表示されます。ブックマークは自分にだけ見えます。
timeline.empty.bookmarks.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty list of bookmarks.

timeline.empty.bookmarks.heading.defaultMessage: まだブックマークはありません
timeline.empty.bookmarks.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the user has bookmarked none.

timeline.empty.home.action.defaultMessage: ローカルタイムラインを見る
timeline.empty.home.action.description: Link from the empty home timeline to the local timeline, where the user can find people to follow.

timeline.empty.home.description.defaultMessage: 自分の投稿と、フォローしている人の投稿がここに表示されます。
timeline.empty.home.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty home timeline.

timeline.empty.home.heading.defaultMessage: ホームタイムラインに投稿はありません
timeline.empty.home.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the home timeline has none.

timeline.empty.local.description.defaultMessage: このサーバーの人の公開投稿がここに表示されます。
timeline.empty.local.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty local timeline.

timeline.empty.local.heading.defaultMessage: まだ投稿はありません
timeline.empty.local.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the local timeline has none.

timeline.empty.public.description.defaultMessage: このサーバーと、つながりのあるサーバーの人の公開投稿がここに表示されます。
timeline.empty.public.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty federated timeline.

timeline.empty.public.heading.defaultMessage: まだ投稿はありません
timeline.empty.public.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the federated timeline has none.

timeline.empty.tag.description.defaultMessage: #{tag} の付いた公開投稿がここに表示されます。
timeline.empty.tag.description.description: Text under the heading of an empty hashtag timeline. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.empty.tag.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when no post has the hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.keyboard_hint.defaultMessage: タイムラインでは Page Down と Page Up で投稿の間を移動できます。
timeline.keyboard_hint.description: Hint for screen reader users before a timeline, about the keys that move from post to post.

timeline.load_more.description: Button at the end of a timeline that loads older posts.

timeline.load_more.failed.defaultMessage: 続きの投稿を読み込めませんでした：{reason}
timeline.load_more.failed.description: Message, read out and shown at the end of a timeline, when older posts failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

timeline.loading.defaultMessage: 投稿を読み込んでいます
timeline.loading.description: Visually hidden text that names the busy region while posts load: the first page of a timeline, or a post page.

timeline.media.no_description.description: Name of a picture of a post whose author gave no description (alternative text), read by screen readers and shown under the picture in the viewer; it is not drawn on the thumbnail.

timeline.media.reveal.defaultMessage: センシティブなメディアを表示
timeline.media.reveal.description: Toggle button over the pictures of a post that the author marked sensitive; it shows or hides them.

timeline.media.audio.play.description: Accessible name of the play button of the audio player of a post's audio attachment.

timeline.media.audio.pause.description: Accessible name of the pause button of the audio player of a post's audio attachment, shown while the audio plays.

timeline.media.audio.seek.description: Accessible name of the seek slider of the audio player of a post's audio attachment; arrow keys move the playback position.

timeline.media.viewer.title.description: Heading of the image viewer, the dialog that shows a picture of a post at its original size when it is pressed. {position} is the place of the picture among the post's pictures, from 1; {count} is how many there are.

timeline.media.viewer.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the image viewer.

timeline.media.viewer.previous.description: Accessible name of the icon button of the image viewer that shows the post's picture before the current one.

timeline.media.viewer.next.description: Accessible name of the icon button of the image viewer that shows the post's next picture.

timeline.media.viewer.position.description: Position of the picture shown in the image viewer among the post's pictures, between its previous and next buttons. {position} is the place of the picture, from 1; {count} is how many there are.

timeline.media.viewer.alt_text.description: Accessible name of the note button of the image viewer that shows or hides the picture's description (alt text) over the picture. The button exists only for a picture that has a description.

timeline.card.author.description: Line under the description of a link card naming the author of the linked page. {author} is the author's name as the page gives it, or the verified account (timeline.card.account).

timeline.card.author_published.description: Line under the description of a link card naming the author of the linked page and when it was published. {author} is the author's name; {date} is the formatted date.

timeline.card.published.description: Line under the description of a link card saying when the linked page was published. {date} is the formatted date.

timeline.card.account.description: The verified author of a linked page as an account: {name} is the display name, {handle} the handle such as @alice@example.com.

timeline.card.failed.defaultMessage: このリンクのプレビューを表示できませんでした。
timeline.card.failed.description: Shown in place of the card of a link in a post when it failed to render.

timeline.new_posts.defaultMessage: {count, plural, other {新しい投稿 # 件}}
timeline.new_posts.description: Button above the home timeline when new posts have arrived; pressing it shows them at the top. Screen readers also read it out when the count changes.

timeline.new_posts.failed.defaultMessage: 新しい投稿を読み込めませんでした：{reason}
timeline.new_posts.failed.description: Message read out when pressing the new posts button failed to load them. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

timeline.offline.home.defaultMessage: オフラインです。{time} 時点の投稿を表示しています。
timeline.offline.home.description: Notice above the home timeline while the device is offline or the server cannot be reached: the posts shown are the ones loaded last, kept on this device. {time} is the date and time they were loaded, already formatted.

timeline.retry.description: Button at the end of a timeline that tries again to load older posts after a failure.

timeline.signed_out.description.defaultMessage: ログインすると、フォローしている人の投稿を読めます。
timeline.signed_out.description.description: Description of the sign-in state that the home page shows when nobody is signed in, under its heading and above the link to sign in.

timeline.signed_out.heading.defaultMessage: ログインしていません
timeline.signed_out.heading.description: Heading on the home page when nobody is signed in, shown instead of the home timeline.

timeline.empty.quotes.heading.defaultMessage: まだ引用されていません
timeline.empty.quotes.heading.description: Heading of the empty list of the posts that quote one of the user's posts.

timeline.empty.quotes.description.defaultMessage: この投稿を引用した投稿がここに表示されます。
timeline.empty.quotes.description.description: Description of the empty list of the posts that quote one of the user's posts.

timeline.load_more.failed.heading.defaultMessage: 続きの投稿を読み込めませんでした
timeline.load_more.failed.heading.description: Heading of the error shown at the end of a timeline when older posts failed to load, above the reason and the button to try again.
